notes.title: A musical update
notes.notes:
The game only had 2 soundtracks for years at this point.
I thought it would be a good idea to change that.
I contacted Kevin Macleod for permission to add some of his music to the game and he gave us permission to do so.

[b]Added the following soundtracks by Kevin Macleod:[/b]
- Dragon and Toast
- Leaving Home
- Man Down
- Mystery Sax
- Night Vigil
- Oppressive Gloom
- Relent
- Serene
- Stay the Course
- Unholy Knight

[b]Fixed the stern of the Goliath (big) where water wouldn't flow[/b]

notes.title: AMD/ATI Hotfix
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone[/h1]

This is a quick post to let you all know the game should be working fine now for everyone
please take note the update has only been pushed on the Testing branch to check it please follow these steps:
- Right click on the game in your steam library
- Click on Proprieties
- Click on the Betas tab
- Select the Testing branch in the drop down menu

If the game works, you should also hear music playing in the background
We will push this update later today if everything works as planned

notes.title: Ship Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

This is a little update to tell you the ships folder should be working fine now
There was an issue with Users permissions that prevented the game to properly extract the ships at the right place, this caused the folder to be empty 

Instead of extracting the ships, we've added all the ships into the game directory and linked that folder instead of a newly generated one

[h1][b]The button should work fine now[/b][/h1]
Take note, if you still have the old empty folder, [u][b]Try reinstalling the game[/b][/u], it's possible that your game didn't updated properly

Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Hotfix 1: Crashing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944196/c7e335ae69b3adcc64d8af2cea2ed188c219d94a.png[/img]

Relentless crashing has caused a lot of frustration among the community, sorry about that.
We hadn't planned for such a massive influx of new players upon launch, which just worsened the situation.

We have isolated the cause of the issue in the GUI framework we used, and have replaced it completely with an alternative.

The new version should be far more stable.
